mapper.insert: INSERT INTO product_daily_sales (sale_date, product_id, units, revenue) VALUES (CURDATE(), #{productId}, #{units}, #{revenue}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE units = units + VALUES(units), revenue = revenue + VALUES(revenue)
mapper.select: SELECT o.order_id, GROUP_CONCAT(p.sku ORDER BY l.line_no SEPARATOR ', ') AS skus FROM customer_order o JOIN order_line l ON l.order_id = o.order_id JOIN product p ON p.product_id = l.product_id WHERE o.customer_id = #{customerId} GROUP BY o.order_id
SELECT DATE_FORMAT(order_date, '%Y-%m') AS order_month, SUM(order_total) AS revenue FROM customer_order WHERE status NOT IN ('cancelled', 'refunded') GROUP BY DATE_FORMAT(order_date, '%Y-%m')
SELECT order_id, order_ref FROM customer_order WHERE order_date >= DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL #{days} DAY)
SELECT order_id, order_date FROM customer_order WHERE order_date >= STR_TO_DATE(#{fromDate}, '%d/%m/%Y')
mapper.insert: REPLACE INTO product_category (category_id, category_code, category_name, is_active) VALUES (#{categoryId}, #{categoryCode}, #{categoryName}, 1)

SELECT LAST_INSERT_ID()
INSERT INTO customer_order (order_ref, customer_id, status, order_total, ship_address_id) VALUES (#{orderRef}, #{customerId}, 'new', #{orderTotal}, #{shipAddressId})
mapper.select: SELECT order_id, status FROM customer_order WHERE order_id = #{orderId} LOCK IN SHARE MODE
SELECT product_id, product_name FROM product WHERE MATCH(product_name, description) AGAINST (#{query} IN NATURAL LANGUAGE MODE)
